title: Mike Kelley: Hermaphrodite Drawings (2005-2006)

description.main: Catalogue of Mike Kelley's 2007 Gagosian London exhibition of large drawings, with an essay by Steven Stern.
description.extended:
A monograph of Mike Kelley's Hermaphrodite Drawings of 2005–2006, shown at Gagosian in London in 2007.

The exhibition ran at Britannia Street from February 6 to March 17, 2007, and was Kelley's first with the gallery in London. The drawings are large, often life-size, and show polymorphous body parts, distorted faces and grotesque figures in the manner of Picasso or de Kooning, updated with Kelley's own wit. The book gives each drawing, and sometimes a crop of one, its own page, and closes with an essay by Steven Stern. The cover is purple board with gilt lettering.

Kelley (1954–2012) worked across drawing, sculpture, installation, painting and video. The exhibition also included a group of recent sculptures that had not been shown before.
